create.name: Steph Magenta
create.bio:
Steph Magenta is a breathwork facilitator and shamanic practitioner who lives in Glastonbury, Somerset, and founded the Seven Directions Breathwork school. Her path into this field began with research work on substance misuse, prompted by struggles of her own, and widened over four decades into bodywork, plant-based cafés and holistic centres. She learned conscious connected breathing with Alchemy of Breath, qualified as an advanced Oxygen Advantage instructor, and has trained within North American, Mexican and British Celtic and Pagan land traditions, naming Abuela Martha Pico as her present mentor.

In her sessions, connected breathing sits alongside drumming, ancestral work, trance dance and ceremony, all held within an animist sense of relationship with the land. She runs a weekly ceremonial breath circle online on Saturday mornings, sees people one to one online or in Glastonbury, and sells recorded breath journeys from her website. Through Seven Directions she leads a ten-month professional facilitator certification, taught with a faculty of trainers in the UK, Europe and North America, and a short self-paced foundations course for newcomers. She hosted The Shift Network's breathwork summit in 2023 and recorded a seven-week course for it.

courses.title: Ceremonial Breathwork Online
courses.description: A weekly live breath circle on Zoom every Saturday from 10 to 11:15am London time. Participants register in advance and are asked to complete a health questionnaire before joining.

courses.title: One-to-One Breathwork and Shamanic Sessions
courses.description: Private sessions of an hour, ninety minutes, two hours or longer, held online or in person in Glastonbury, mixing breathwork with shamanic practice. Immersive days and weekends can also be arranged, and a free fifteen-minute introductory call is offered.

courses.title: The Seventh Direction: A 40 Minute Shamanic Breathwork Journey
courses.description: A recorded journey for experienced breathers that closes the Seven Directions sacred circle, with icaros and sound carrying the listener through imagined rainforest and desert landscapes. Cues are sparse once the journey is under way.

courses.title: Cultivating Eros: 40 Minute Guided Breathwork Journey
courses.description: A recorded session that draws life-force energy up through the seven chakras before opening into a freer, less guided phase. Music is by Charlie Roscoe.

courses.title: Higher Consciousness: 35 Minute Guided Breathwork Journey
courses.description: A shorter recorded breath journey aimed at expanded states of awareness, with Steph's guidance over music by Charlie Roscoe.

courses.title: Seven Directions 400+ Hour Professional Breathwork Certification (International Cohort)
courses.description: A ten-month hybrid training in conscious connected breathwork that takes students from facilitator to advanced practitioner level, with mentoring and an in-person weekend midway. The international cohort led by Steph meets on Tuesday evenings, London time.

courses.title: Foundations of Breathwork
courses.description: A four-module self-paced introduction from Seven Directions covering everyday functional breathing and connected breathwork. It is meant for beginners and those wanting a refresher, not as a certification.

Regional: based in Glastonbury, Somerset (town of about 9,000), outside the big cities.
Only one photo confirmed: her headshot on the Seven Directions faculty page (sevendirectionsbreathwork.com/our-faculty). Her own site's images are mostly stock, action shots or a Shift promo graphic.
The Seven Directions faculty page gives her name as Stephanie Gail Wilcock (Steph Magenta); listed under Steph Magenta, as she presents publicly.
Ceremonial Breathwork Online: weekly Saturday class on her events page; no price stated, so 'Contact for pricing'.
Two offerings (certification and foundations course) are on sevendirectionsbreathwork.com, the school she founded and leads; counted under the founder rule.
Her YouTube channel is mostly a conversation series with guest breathworkers; the Alan Dolan conversation is kept as a two-way talk on mysticism and breathwork.
Her My Message page mentions past work with plant medicines; her main work is breathwork and shamanic practice, so the plant-medicine rule was not applied.
Email is a Gmail address on her contact page; a second address (lifealchemytherapies@gmail.com) appears on her imprint page.

Dated events on her events page (2023 to 2025 retreats, festivals, Mexico City and Manchester events): all past.
In-person 12-month UK programme launching July 2027: no page or price of its own yet.
YouTube 'Die Healthy! Longevity...' (health framing), 'Abuse in Breathwork' (personal statement, not teaching), short clips under 2 minutes, and guest-led interviews.
